<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlinePurchase" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-purchase">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlinePurchase" name="Online Purchase" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderStarted" name="Order started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log in to account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Login</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_SplitA</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Setup_Split" name="Split setup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Login_SplitA</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitA_SelectItems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitA_SetPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectItems" name="Select items to purchase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitA_SelectItems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectItems_SplitB</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPaymentMethod" name="Set payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitA_SetPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SetPayment_JoinA</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Reward_Split" name="Split after item selection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectItems_SplitB</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitB_ChooseReward</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitB_JoinA</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseReward" name="Choose free reward option">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitB_ChooseReward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseReward_JoinB</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Setup_Join" name="Join selection and payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitB_JoinA</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SetPayment_JoinA</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinA_PaySplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Split" name="Pay or installment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinA_PaySplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaySplit_Pay</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaySplit_Installment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Pay" name="Pay">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaySplit_Pay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Pay_PayMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteInstallment" name="Complete installment agreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaySplit_Installment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Installment_PayMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Merge" name="Payment completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Pay_PayMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Installment_PayMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PayMerge_JoinB</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Fulfilment_Join" name="Join payment and reward">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PayMerge_JoinB</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseReward_JoinB</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinB_DeliverMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delivery_Merge" name="Delivery required">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinB_DeliverMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnItems_DeliverMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeliverMerge_Deliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverItems" name="Deliver items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeliverMerge_Deliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deliver_ReturnSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Return_Split" name="Items returned for exchange?" default="Flow_ReturnSplit_End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deliver_ReturnSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnSplit_ReturnItems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnSplit_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return items for exchange">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnSplit_ReturnItems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnItems_DeliverMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnSplit_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Login" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderStarted" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_SplitA" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitA_SelectItems" sourceRef="Gateway_Setup_Split" targetRef="Task_SelectItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitA_SetPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_Setup_Split" targetRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectItems_SplitB" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Gateway_Reward_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitB_ChooseReward" sourceRef="Gateway_Reward_Split" targetRef="Task_ChooseReward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitB_JoinA" sourceRef="Gateway_Reward_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetPayment_JoinA" sourceRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinA_PaySplit" sourceRef="Gateway_Setup_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaySplit_Pay" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaySplit_Installment" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_CompleteInstallment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pay_PayMerge" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Installment_PayMerge" sourceRef="Task_CompleteInstallment" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PayMerge_JoinB" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Fulfilment_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseReward_JoinB" sourceRef="Task_ChooseReward" targetRef="Gateway_Fulfilment_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinB_DeliverMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_Fulfilment_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliverMerge_Deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_ReturnSplit" sourceRef="Task_DeliverItems" targetRef="Gateway_Return_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnSplit_ReturnItems" sourceRef="Gateway_Return_Split" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${returnForExchange == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnItems_DeliverMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnSplit_End" sourceRef="Gateway_Return_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
